heading: Purchase of paper in open market
lead: The Joint Committee on Printing may authorize the Director of the Government Publishing Office to purchase paper in open market when they consider the quantity required so small or the want so immediate as not to justify advertisement for proposals.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–235 substituted “Director of the Government Publishing Office” for “Public Printer”.
